cases.name: blit-sampling-reference-default
cases.reference_source: EXPORT BSAMP0() BEGIN DIMGROB_P(G1,3,3); LOCAL x,y,r,out:={}; FOR y FROM 0 TO 2 DO FOR x FROM 0 TO 2 DO PIXON_P(G1,x,y,100*(y+1)+x+1); END; END; DIMGROB_P(G2,8,8); RECT_P(G2,0); IFERR r:=BLIT_P(G2,G1); THEN r:="error"; END; FOR y FROM 0 TO GROBH_P(G2)-1 DO FOR x FROM 0 TO GROBW_P(G2)-1 DO out:=CONCAT(out,{GETPIX_P(G2,x,y)}); END; END; RETURN {r,GROBW_P(G2),GROBH_P(G2),out}; END;
